cluster_summary: This cluster comprises 40 XWiki vulnerabilities, primarily server-side template injection (SSTI) and cross-site scripting (XSS), caused by user-controlled data being interpolated into templates without proper context-specific escaping (HTML, wiki syntax, or URL). Variants include incomplete delimiter escaping, bypassing the rendering pipeline, misconfigured output directives, unsafe wrapper removal, direct code evaluation, and one unrelated error-handling issue.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the guard is enforced before the sensitive effect and remains bound to the same resource, principal, destination, or object that the effect uses. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Apply escapetool.xml() or equivalent HTML/XML escaping function to all dynamic values before embedding in HTML..

mechanism.missing_guard: the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect

sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled values are interpolated into HTML attributes or text nodes without applying HTML entity encoding, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript.
